MOUSEGUARD.SystemDescription: A system for playing the Mouse Guard RPG in Foundry VTT.
MOUSEGUARD.Trait.graceful.Description: This trait describes a distinctive quality, habit, or reputation that can shape how the mouse acts and how others respond.
MOUSEGUARD.Trait.graceful.Level1: Once per session, add +1D to an appropriate test when the trait gives a clear advantage.
MOUSEGUARD.Trait.graceful.Level2: Twice per session, add +1D to two appropriate tests when the trait gives a clear advantage.
MOUSEGUARD.Trait.graceful.Level3: Use the trait without a session limit for its level benefit; resolve ties in the mouse’s favor when the trait clearly applies.
MOUSEGUARD.Trait.graceful.Against: The player may invoke the trait to complicate the mouse’s actions or put them at a disadvantage. Agree on a consequence with the GM; an earned check is awarded only when the rules and situation permit.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Apiarist.Name: Apiarist
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Apiarist.Description: Knowledge and care of bees, their colonies, and the harvesting of honey and wax.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Apiarist.Supplies: Protective clothing, smoke, hives, and appropriate containers for honey or wax.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Apiarist.Factors: Colony size and temperament, season, weather, hive condition, and the quality or quantity of the harvest.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Apiarist.Help: An apiary-wise mouse or another mouse familiar with the colony, local plants, or beekeeping can help when their knowledge applies.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Administrator.Descripti: Администратор uses specialized knowledge and practiced techniques to accomplish work related to this profession.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Administrator.Supplies: Appropriate tools and materials for the task; access to a suitable workspace when needed.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Administrator.Factors: Task complexity, available time, quality of materials and tools, working conditions, and the required outcome.
MOUSEGUARD.Skill.Administrator.Help: A knowledgeable mouse can help when their skills and contribution are relevant to the task.

SETTINGS.MouseGuardMacroShorthandL: Enable a shortened macro syntax which allows referencing attributes directly, for example @str instead of @attributes.str.value. Disable this setting if you need the ability to reference the full attribute model, for example @attributes.str.label.
SETTINGS.MouseGuardInitFormulaL: Enter an initiative formula, such as d20+@dex
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyGroupAttrDuplicate: Attribute group already exists as an attribute.
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyGroupAlphanumeric: Attribute group names may not contain spaces or periods.
MOUSEGUARD.NotifyAttrDuplicate: Attribute key already exists as a group.
MOUSEGUARD.DeleteGroupContent: Do you wish to delete this group? This will delete the following group and all attributes included in it:
MOUSEGUARD.Name: Name
MOUSEGUARD.FateSub: One point allows you to reroll any axes (AXEICON) as new dice
MOUSEGUARD.PersonaSub: Add one die per point spent or tap Nature
MOUSEGUARD.BeliefSub: Playing a Belief earns a Fate Point
MOUSEGUARD.GoalSub: Accomplishing a goal earns a Persona Point
MOUSEGUARD.InstinctSub: Playing an Instinct earns a Fate Point
MOUSEGUARD.GearTagSub: Gear is limited to what you can carry. Possessions are kept in Lockhaven aor another location
MOUSEGUARD.hungthurstToolTip: Hungry, Thursty: -1 to disposition to any conflict.
MOUSEGUARD.angrySub: -1 to disposition to any conflict that uses Will as its base.
MOUSEGUARD.angryToolTip: Angry: (Ob 2 will) -1 to disposition to any conflict that uses Will as its base.
MOUSEGUARD.tiredToolTip: Tired: (Ob 3 Health) -1 to disposition to any conflict
MOUSEGUARD.injuredSub: -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.injuredToolTip: Injured: (Ob 4 Health) -1D to skills, Nature, Will and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.sickSub: -1D to skills, Nature, WIll and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.sickToolTip: Sick: (Ob 4 Will) -1D to skills, Nature, WIll and Health (but not recovery)
MOUSEGUARD.TraitBenefitsSub: Level 1: +1D per session; Level 2: +1D twice per session; Level 3: Reroll failed dice once per session.
COMBAT.askGoal: Ask Conflict Captain for the Goal
COMBAT.Goal: What is the Goal of this Conflict?
COMBAT.CCSet: A Conflict Captain Has Already Been Set.
COMBAT.NeedCC: A Conflict Captain Must Be Set.
COMBAT.NeedGoal: A Goal must be defined to start a combat. Sending Goal Request to Conflict Captain.
COMBAT.CCERROR: A Conflict Captain may not switch teams.
